question: Bishop is used in which of the following games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **bishop **is a piece in the board game of chess. Each player begins the game with two bishops. The bishop moves along a diagonal line on the board. It is one of the pieces that plays a major role in the early part of the game.
 
• The golden rule of chess is a piece is safe only as long as it is defended by the same number of pieces that are attacking it.
 
• If your opponent attacks one of your pieces, count the number of your pieces that defend it immediately to make sure that it is safe.
 
• The fifty-move rule in chess states that a player can claim a draw if no capture has been made and no pawn has been moved in the last fifty consecutive moves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Competitive cricket** is essentially a bat and ball sport. It is played by two teams on an oval and involves batting, fielding, and bowling.
 
• Billiards, any of various games played on a rectangular table with a designated number of small balls and a long stick called a cue.
 
• **Badminton **is a racket sport played by either two opposing players (singles) or two opposing pairs (doubles), who take positions on opposite halves of a rectangular court that is divided by a net.
